_note: Signature starting gear of the four Ember Road companions (companions.json startingItems): Bruna, Ysolde, Liora and Nanami. Item level 15-20, Uncommon/Rare, budget per Docs/Expansion.md §8 (stats 0.55 × ilvl × Qa × slot, weapon DPS ×0.72/0.79, ArmorValue armour), requiredLevel = ilvl − 5 so each is wearable where its owner is met. Unique, like the valley companions' gear; StartingGear never hands them out.

items.name: Barn-Door Bulwark
items.description: Cut from the old Haybright barn door, hinges and all. The sunflower was painted by five small brothers, so it has eleven petals and a face.

items.name: Harvest-Moon Billhook
items.description: For hedges, brambles and the occasional gnoll. Bruna sharpens it on the doorstep every Sunday, whether it needs it or not.

items.name: Sunflower Smock Hauberk
items.description: A harvest-orange smock over honest mail. There are barley seeds in every pocket, and nobody knows how.

items.name: Heronguard Kite Shield
items.description: Tall, river-blue and dented in forty places. A single white heron feather is tied to the rim; she replaces it every spring.

items.name: Arming Sword of the Last Watch
items.description: Plain steel, perfectly kept. The Heronguard's motto is etched along the fuller: 'Bring them home.'

items.name: Riverblue Surcoat
items.description: Faded river-blue over polished mail. The heron on its breast has been stitched and restitched until it is more thread than bird.

items.name: Chapel Lantern-Censer
items.description: A little brass lantern on a long chain. Swing it slowly and the light follows, like a cat that has decided to trust you.

items.name: Riverstep Prayer-Mace
items.description: Mostly used for cracking the ice on the river steps in winter. Occasionally used for cracking other things.

items.name: Robe of Small Lights
items.description: Plum and white, with four hundred and twelve tiny lanterns embroidered round the hem. And a goat.

items.name: Tidesinger's Conch Staff
items.description: Driftwood, a conch and a great many little bells. When Nanami sings, the conch hums along a third below.

items.name: Shell-Bead Tide Wrap
items.description: Sea-green and fen-grey, sewn with river shells that click like rain on a tin roof.

items.name: Sending-Song Shells
items.description: Seven river shells on a cord, one for every verse of the sending song. The last shell is still blank.
